## Page 6

SOLAR ROOFTOP
Overall  solar  farm  performance  
increased  by 1.2% YoY,  driven  by the 
SPN repowering  recovery  in 3Q25–
4Q25 and higher  irradiance  in Japan,  
partially  offset  by weaker  irradiance  in 
Vietnam  and Mongolia . In addition,  
revenue  recognition  from  electricity  
sales  under  the PPA for the Leo 2 
project  in Japan  commenced  on 4 
November  2025 , ahead  of schedule .Wind  farm  performance  rose  6.7% YoY,  
supported  by stronger  wind  speeds  at 
Romklao wind  farm  in Thailand  and  
following  the acquisition  of a 100% 
equity  stake . However,  TTTV  wind  farm  
in Vietnam  declined  13.4% YoY due to a 
temporary  shutdowns  during  1H25 to 
replace  the subsea  cable  transmission  
line.Biomass  performance  in Thailand  
slightly  declined  by 0.6% YoY,  mainly  
due to higher  maintenance  shutdown  
days . Solar  rooftop  projects  increased  from  
112 to 130 in 2025 , raising  capacity  to 
50.9 MW,  mainly  driven  by 6 new  
projects  in Thailand  (+5.2 MW) . Reflect  
to a performance  increasing  by 4.3% 
despite  lower  irradiance  in Thailand  
and Indonesia .SOLAR FARM WIND FARM BIOMASS

Revenue from electricity sales and services
Revenue from electricity sales, services and other products decreased by 10.6% YoY.
•Revenue from electricity sales decreased by 107.9 million baht, or 11.2% mainly due to: 
(1)The expiration of the SPN project Adder 
(2)Lower wind speeds in Thailand and Vietnam 
(3)A longer maintenance shutdown for the UPT biomass 
(4)Lower irradiance in Solar Rooftop Thailand and Indonesia
(5)Appreciation of the Thai Baht 
(6)Reduction in the fuel tariff (Ft)
